# PEP Words

> Free PEP (People's Education Press) English vocabulary tool for Chinese primary and middle school learners.

- Site: https://pep-words.brainrush.run/
- Maker: Liz (https://lizliz.xyz/)
- Category: EducationalApplication / vocabulary study tool
- Price: Free, no account required
- Languages: zh-CN (default), English UI toggle
- Datasets: primary school ~1331 entries; middle school ~2895 entries
- Features: search + definitions, favorites + CSV export, flashcards, multiple-choice quiz, raw word-list reading
- Indexable word pages: /seo/ (primary-school, middle-school letter and word pages)
- Legacy visual comparison: /legacy-blue

## What it is not

- Not a paid course, tutoring marketplace, or account-based SaaS
- Not affiliated with People's Education Press beyond using PEP vocabulary lists for study
